description: How many orders the company has, in total or at given outlets — 'how many orders do we have', 'how busy is the King Street shop'. Cheap: it counts, it loads no order data. It counts EVERY order ever recorded and takes no date, status or source filter. For anything time-boxed or filtered, call get_orders and read its `matching` count, or use get_financial_summary for a period.

outlets.description: Outlet ids to restrict to. Omit to count every outlet

name: hub_get_order_count
title: Count orders
